<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="a7IuCPILjhGt9xV0xU2e"> <mxGraphModel dx="2128" dy="663" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam nodesep 40
skinparam ranksep 50
skinparam defaultTextAlignment center
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

' Global Styling
skinparam rectangle {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor Black
 BorderThickness 1.5
 RoundCorner 5
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color Black
 Thickness 1
}

title Weather-Aware DRL Cooperative Decision System Architecture

' --- Initialization ---
rectangle \"Initialization & Configuration\" as Init {
 json \"Environmental Settings\" as EnvSettings {
 \"1\": \"Route/Map Topology\",
 \"2\": \"Traffic Density\",
 \"3\": \"Weather Profiles\",
 \"4\": \"Vehicle Parameters\"
 }
}

' --- Module 1 ---
rectangle \"Module 1: Simulation & \nEnvironmental Data Prep\" as Mod1 {
 rectangle \"CARLA Simulator \nEnvironment\" as CarlaEnv {
 rectangle \"CarlaSim\" as CS1
 }
 
 rectangle \"Generators & \nEnvironmental Physics\" as GenPhys {
 rectangle \"(1) Heterogeneous \nTraffic Generator\n(IDM/Model Models)\" as TrafficGen
 rectangle \"(2) Weather Physics Engine\nDynamic Friction Calibration\nCalculation\" as PhysEngine
 
 TrafficGen -[hidden]- PhysEngine
 }
 
 CarlaEnv -[hidden]--> GenPhys
}

' --- Module 2 ---
rectangle \"Module 2: Weather-Aware \nDRL Cooperative Decision\" as Mod2 {
 rectangle \"Centralized Critic Network\n(Global Platoon State Evaluation)\" as Critic {
 rectangle \"CentralCritic\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"Decentralized Actor Networks\n(Local Control Policies)\" as Actors {
 rectangle \"DecenActors\"
 }
 
 Critic -[hidden]- Actors
}

' --- Module 3 ---
rectangle \"Module 3: Weather-Aware \nSafety Shield\" as Mod3 {
 rectangle \"Dynamic Headway\nBoundary Planner\n(d_safe = f(v, mu))\" as Headway {
 rectangle \"HeadwayBound\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"Collision Risk Verification\nAction Override Logic\" as Risk {
 rectangle \"TwinMask\"
 }
 
 Headway -[hidden]- Risk
}

' --- Module 4 ---
rectangle \"Module 4: Low-Level \nKinematic Control\" as Mod4 {
 rectangle \"Knowledge-Based Finite\nContinuous Actuation\nMode Selection\" as FSM {
 rectangle \"FSM_Select\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"Bicycle Kinematic Model\nContinuous Actuation\nTraction\" as Bicycle {
 rectangle \"BicycleModel\"
 }
 
 FSM -[hidden]- Bicycle
}

' --- Module 5 ---
rectangle \"Module 5: Real-Time AI \nMonitoring Dashboard\" as Mod5 {
 rectangle \"FastSocket\nAsynchronous Server\" as FastSocket {
 rectangle \"FastAPIServer\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"WebSocket\nLive Streaming Server\" as WS {
 rectangle \"WS_Stream\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"React Interactive Frontend UI\" as React {
 rectangle \"2D Platoon Trajectories\"
 rectangle \"Spacing Threshold Graphs\"
 rectangle \"Active Weather Gauges\"
 rectangle \"ReactUI\"
 }
 
 FastSocket --> WS
 WS --> React
}

' --- Module 6 ---
rectangle \"Module 6: System \nEvaluation & Benchmark Analysis\" as Mod6 {
 rectangle \"SIL Disturbance \nScenarios Metrics:\nMin TTC Calculation\nMax DRAC Matrix\" as SILMetrics {
 rectangle \"MetricsCalc\"
 }
 
 rectangle \"Post-Simulation Evaluation & \nBenchmark Deliverables\" as PostSim {
 rectangle \"ScenarioConfig\" as ScenConfig
 rectangle \"Safety & Efficiency\nMetrics Calculator\" as SafeCalc
 rectangle \"Baseline Comparative Metrics\n(vs DQN, PPO, SLPLC, SIPLC)\" as Baseline
 rectangle \"Outputs:\nStatistical Evaluation Matrix\" as Outputs
 
 ScenConfig -> SafeCalc
 SafeCalc -> Baseline
 Baseline -> Outputs
 }
}

' --- Main Flows ---

' 1. Init to Mod 1
Init -down-> Mod1 : Initial Settings

' 2. Mod 1 Internal & Out
CS1 -down-> GenPhys
GenPhys -right-> Mod2 : Normalized Platoon \nState Tensor (S_t)
GenPhys -down-> Mod3 : Weather Friction Index (mu)

' 3. Mod 2 to Mod 3
Mod2 -right-> Mod3 : Proposed Action Vector (A_pro)
Critic -down-> Actors

' 4. Mod 3 to Mod 4
Mod3 -right-> Mod4 : Verified Safe Action Vector (A_safe)
Headway -down-> Risk

' 5. Mod 4 Outputs
FSM -down-> Bicycle
Bicycle -up-> Mod5 : 15 Hz Telemetry \nFeed Stream
Bicycle -down-> Mod6 : Real-Time Action \nOverride Logs

' 6. Feedback Loop (The Big One)
Bicycle -left-> Mod1 : Continuous Actuation Signals\n(Throttle, Brake Pressure,\nSteering Angle)

@enduml
",
